answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the reef accrues. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its jade from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. Scaling the timber therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal 1gvck.
